findings.text: follow-on: the done-when's population clause - the test files importing reckon.crew.dispatch, reckon.crew.promotion or reckon.crew.runs add no failure against base - was not established, because the head population run (head-population-direct.log) died on /tmp exhaustion with 27 failed, 240 errors, EXIT=123, so no base-vs-head delta exists; the manifest's tests field nevertheless cites that invalid run. The focused arms are valid but cover only the node's own new test file, so collateral regressions in the import population are unmeasured and a population rerun in a scratch tree with adequate space is owed.

follow-on: the node's write scope (dispatch.py, promotion.py) overlaps the write scopes of two concurrent nodes (a-held-member-and-a-silent-launch-are-read, an-empty-worktree-field-is-absent), which both list dispatch.py or promotion.py; the edits here are within the node's own grant and isolated in its worktree, so this is not a worker fault, but the overlap is a merge-time risk the orchestrator should sequence when landing.

justifications.durability: the change is pinned by focused regression tests that travel the real resolve_session seam and prove the guard fires - the base arm red with 5 failures and the committed head green - covering same-task reuse, capture, promotion recovery, promotion-row identity and the resumed flag; tests isolate state under a tmp RECKON_HOME; the shared resolution preserves the pre-promotion guard's swallow-on-unreadable behaviour (_stream_session catches CrewError/OSError/ValueError, _ledger_session catches broadly); docked because the population delta that would catch collateral breakage in importing test files is missing and _complete_locked's resolved-row identity has no direct test.
justifications.evidence: the focused arms are strong and reproduce: base 060d94f50 fails 5 of 6 with real assertion diffs (EXIT=1), head ecb16a953 passes 6 of 6 (EXIT=0), and an independent re-run at the head returned 6 passed; the declared negative control is the base arm, whose header names module.__file__=/tmp/reckon-session-base.nmqwve/reckon/crew/dispatch.py and the measurement cwd, and whose failing ids the head arm does not fail; baseline_suite and after_suite are armed JSON with completed:true, exit_status, failure_count and failure_ids, digestible from the reviewed run's own logs; docked because the only population-wide artefact is an invalid run (storage-driven, no code comparison possible) and the manifest's tests field nevertheless cites it.
justifications.fit: the change follows s36 exactly - every reader keys on the one shared resolution rather than the raw field - reuses resolve_session with no duplicated logic, keeps lazy local imports matching the file's existing pattern, updates the _recoverable_session docstring to state the single-source contract, and adds the ledger as a source where the promotion guard previously omitted it; the record['session_id'] write-back in capture_run_session matches the incident's own repair-on-read behaviour.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node's core deliverable is met and independently reproduced - same-task dispatch reuse now finds a prior run whose raw session_id is empty over a stream naming a thread (5 new focused tests plus the ledger-fallback case), and every reader the coordinator's s36 comment listed is either keyed on resumption.resolve_session (dispatch.py _prior_same_task_run/_task_session_resolution/_current_harness_session/record_resumption, promotion.py _recoverable_session/_complete_locked, runs.py capture_run_session) or stated with file and line as not deciding resumability (promotion.py:4289 uses the raw field only to look up an optional rollout receipt); docked because the done-when's third clause - the 327-file import population adds no failure against base - was not established: the head population run died on /tmp exhaustion (27 failed, 240 errors, EXIT=123) so no delta exists.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff writes exactly the four product/test paths in the node's grant (reckon/crew/dispatch.py, promotion.py, runs.py, tests/test_dispatch_reads_the_resolved_session.py), declares the fragment and figure paths but correctly writes neither (the prompt names no figure and the node is small), leaves the worktree clean at ecb16a953, commits with conventional subjects and bodies and no AI trailer, and uses no plan labels in names or comments.
